change.description: Add bounded contention observations and module-specific Grafana comparisons

planned.reasoning: Add fixed Prometheus metric families and compatible dashboard capabilities while preserving business APIs, scheduling and durable formats.

current.reasoning: New collector interfaces and long-tail histogram buckets are additive; existing metric semantics and application series limits are preserved.

verified.reasoning: Current integrated candidate validation, controlled overhead and Grafana evidence are pending.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing HTTP/SSE consumers and existing Prometheus queries remain supported; added fixed metrics do not change response fields.

persistent_state.state_description: Observations and cached handles are process memory; no SQLite, journal, raw-file or projection-format migration occurs in the observability release.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: All durable formats supported by the baseline remain unchanged.
